_note: Per-cockpit seat offsets (root local space). Stage A reads DriverSeatOffsetX/Y/Z in DriverSeatServer and PassengerSeatOffsetX/Y/Z in VehicleBuildService.addPassengerSeat; the seat part (2.2 x 0.45 x 2.2) is placed with its centre at root.CFrame * CFrame.new(offset). build_content.py derives the values from the spec driver dummy unless an override is given below.

rule._rootPartCentreAboveSeatTop: ASSUMPTION until pilotAcceptance says otherwise: Roblox seats a character with its HumanoidRootPart centre 1.5 studs above the seat top (SeatWeld C0 = seat top, C1 = (0,-1.5,0) for a standard 2-stud root part). The R15 torso is centred on the root part, so seat centre Y = dummy torso centre Y - 1.5 - seatSize.Y/2. measure_seat.lua reports the real number in the pilot Play test.
rule._tradeOff: An Exotic cabin is about 3.8 studs high inside (floor top Y 0, Wedge roof underside Y 3.83). A seated R15 avatar needs about 4.4 (feet about 2.25 below the root part centre, head top about 2.2 above it). With the torso on the dummy (seat Y -0.325, root part at Y 1.4) the head sits where the dummy head is (top about Y 3.6, under the roof) and the feet end about 0.45 below the tub underside. With INTERFACE.md's first guess (seat Y about 0.25, root part at Y 1.975) the feet stay inside and the head goes about 0.3 through the Wedge roof. This file follows the dummy torso, so the derived seat Y (-0.325) is 0.575 lower than the INTERFACE.md figure. The pilot Play test decides, and the decision is recorded in pilotAcceptance.

pilotAcceptance._decision: pending | measured | overrides. pending: nothing measured yet; the pilot scope builds and applies (the installer reports a WARN), the full scope does not APPLY (build_content.py refuses to build it and the full AUDIT reports a BLOCKER). measured: measure_seat.lua was run in the pilot Play test; put its rootPartCentreAboveSeatTop in measuredRootPartCentreAboveSeatTop, say when and where in measuredOn, and set rule.rootPartCentreAboveSeatTop to the same number (within 0.01) unless every cockpit has an override. overrides: no measurement is used; every cockpit in scope has explicit values in overrides (for example the INTERFACE.md figure).

_overrides: Optional, per cockpit: {"driver": [x, y, z], "passenger": [x, y, z]} (seat centre, root local space, each number within +-40). An override replaces the derived values for that cockpit.
